description: Chat Completions choice, emitted one item per choice. There is NO `text` key — read the reply from `$json.message.content`.

content.description: The assistant's reply as a plain STRING. With Output Content as JSON enabled the node parses it into an object instead — see the `structured` schema variant. May be null when the model returned tool calls.

tool_calls.description: Populated instead of `content` when the model called a tool
